title_sq: Zyre per shije te rruga Frang Bardhi ( Kodra e Diellit)
description_sq:
Shitet ambient biznesi te Kodra e Diellit. Ambjenti momentalisht eshte i ndare ne disa ambiente dhe eshte i dhene me qira por mund edhe te perdoret si Open Space.
Ka nje siperfaqe prej 156,6 m2.
Ndodhet buze rruge dhe eshte lehtesisht i aksesueshem.
title_en: Taste office on Frang Bardhi street (Kodra e Diellit)
description_en: Business premises for sale in Kodra e Diellit. The space is currently divided into several spaces and is rented out, but it can also be used as an Open Space. It has a surface of 156.6 m2. It is located on the side of the road and is easily accessible.
